scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:api-gateway && npm run build:notification-worker && npm run build:catalog-service
scripts.db:generate: npm run db:generate:notification-worker && npm run db:generate:catalog-service
scripts.test: npm run test:api-gateway && npm run test:notification-worker && npm run test:catalog-service
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:web && npm run typecheck:services
scripts.typecheck:services: npm run typecheck:api-gateway && npm run typecheck --workspace @mileshop/notification-worker && npm run typecheck --workspace @mileshop/catalog-service
